thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for PROD · auth-service · jwt-verify-errors
incident-bot: Trigger: auth.jwt.verify_errors rate > 5% (now 12%) over 5m. Affected endpoints: /v1/token/validate, /v1/session/verify. Count ~120/min. Severity: P1. Pager: auth-svc-jwt-verify
pagerduty: Page acknowledged by Alex Chen (primary)
Alex Chen: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and recent deploys. @Maya @Chris stand by if I need help.
Alex Chen: first pass: rolling window shows error spike started right after a deploy at 03:42 UTC to auth-signer. Errors are 401s with "invalid kid" and "signature mismatch" traces.
Chris Liu: I merged the signing change 03:41 UTC (PR #4321) that adds kid normalization for rotated keys. No infra changes. Reverting is low-risk.
Maya Patel: copying runbook steps for key mismatch (runbook/auth/jwks-mismatch). Suggest immediate fallback to previous signing key and flush JWKS cache.
Samira Khan: I can flip the env var to point to previous KMS key id. On Dedicated that is SIGNER_KEY_ID=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/auth/cryptoKeys/sign-key-old.
Alex Chen: doing that now. Will also throttle auth-svc to prevent cascade and enable circuit breaker for token validation route.
Chris Liu: re-rolled signer service to previous image (auth-signer:v2.14 -> v2.13) on prod-1. Watch logs.
Alex Chen: logs show lots of client tokens with kid="k_new_202604" being rejected; older kid k_old_202509 still present. Looks like clients cached new kid but backend didn't have the public key propagated.
Maya Patel: flushing JWKS caches across edge and services. Command: 
```
# flush JWKS cache
redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 PUBLISH jwks-refresh ""
curl -X POST https://edge-internal/api/refresh-jwks -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"
```
Alex Chen: performed redis publish and posted refresh to edge. Metrics: auth.jwt.verify_errors dropping (12% -> 6% over 2m).
pagerduty: Escalation: paging second on-call (Maya Patel) per escalation policy.
Maya Patel: I'm taking over from Alex for ongoing mitigation and handoff (04:05 UTC). Alex — leave notes here for final status.
Alex Chen: handoff: rolled signer back to v2.13 on prod-1/2, switched SIGNER_KEY_ID to sign-key-old in staging and prod, flushed caches, created a temporary request-rate limit on /v1/token/validate. Created INC-2026-349876 in tracker.
Jordan (Customer Ops): seeing 401 spikes in customer telemetry for two enterprise tenants (acct-ACME, acct-BETA). Sending an initial status to their CSMs now. ETA for customer-facing post?
Maya Patel: I'll draft statuspage/ops note: "Partial auth failures impacting token validation for some customers; mitigation in progress, may require token refresh from clients." Jordan please post after I approve.
Chris Liu: root cause hypothesis: the normalization change produced kid header format that didn't match how the rotating JWKS were stored, so runtime key lookup failed for certain tokens. Fix is to ensure signing emits compatible kid or rotate JWKS to include both forms for transition window.
Samira Khan: short-term mitigation complete: old key back, caches flushed. Long-term: we need a canary + compatibility check during signer deploys. I'll open an RFC.
Maya Patel: monitoring shows verify_errors ~1.8% now (baseline 0.3%). Still seeing tail. Keeping page open for next 30m.
Alex Chen: a few operational notes: 1) do not rotate keys until we update clients and add compatibility layer; 2) we'll run a controlled key rotation across regions with feature flag; 3) open follow-up ticket to add JWKS propagation check to deployment pipeline.
Jordan (Customer Ops): update posted to affected customers and status page draft queued (Sat 04:12 UTC). No escalations requested yet but legal/enterprise alerted for ACME.
Maya Patel: handoff summary to night on-call: mitigation applied (fallback key + cache flush), signer service rolled back on prod nodes, monitoring shows regression improvement. Follow-ups: fix PR #4321 for kid normalization, add deploy-time JWKS validation, add automated canary for signing changes.
Alex Chen: handing back to Maya. I've updated INC-2026-349876 with actions and timelines. Handoff complete. :handshake:
Maya Patel: ack, will own until the follow-ups are closed. Closing page once metrics stable for 30m and no customer escalations.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (auto-clear) — incident still being tracked manually.
Maya Patel: final note: will schedule postmortem meeting and include client impact window and mitigation timeline.
Chris Liu: adding detailed logs/trace links to the ticket now.
Jordan (Customer Ops): keeping customer comms open. Will notify if any CSMs escalate.
Alex Chen: thanks team. Good coordination.
Maya Patel: thanks — will update thread with postmortem link when ready.
